# AI Ark

AI Ark provides people and company search, contact enrichment, and recruiting intelligence APIs.

Category: Recruiting & HR. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ai-ark/.

## Actions

- **Analyze Personality** (read-only): Infer DISC and OCEAN personality assessments plus selling and hiring outreach guidance from one person's LinkedIn profile.
- **Create or Update List**: Create or mutate a temporary people/company exclusion list for free.
- **Enrich Person with Email** (read-only): Enrich one person by AI Ark person ID or LinkedIn URL with a full profile and provider email-verification metadata.
- **Find Mobile Phone** (read-only): Find candidate mobile phone numbers for one person from a LinkedIn URL or from a company domain plus full name.
- **Get Credit Balance** (read-only): Return the connected AI Ark account's remaining credit balance for free.
- **Get Email Finder Status** (read-only): Make one free status request for an email-finder job and return its state and total/found counts.
- **Get People Export Status** (read-only): Make one free status request for a bulk people-export job and return its state, total/found/success/failed counts, and webhook metadata.
- **List Email Finder Results** (read-only): Return one free page of an email-finder job's results without waiting for completion.
- **List Email Finder Submissions** (read-only): Return one free page of the connected AI Ark customer's email-finder submission history, including job states and refund details.
- **List People Export Results** (read-only): Return one free page of a completed bulk people export.
- **List People Export Submissions** (read-only): List the authenticated API token's own people-export submission and refund history for free.
- **Look Up Person by Email** (read-only): Identify and return a sensitive, detailed personal and employment profile from an email address.
- **Preview People** (read-only): Return one page of masked people and full company matches for 1 credit per page.
- **Resend Email Finder Webhook**: Irreversibly resend one email-finder completion payload to a caller-selected public HTTPS webhook.
- **Resend People Export Webhook**: Irreversibly resend one completed bulk people export to a caller-selected public HTTPS webhook.
- **Search Companies** (read-only): Return one zero-based page of companies using typed company, employee, list, and lookalike filters.
- **Search People** (read-only): Return one page of full people and company profiles.
- **Start Email Finder**: Consume a People Search track ID exactly once, within 6 hours of the search, to start email finding.
- **Start People Export**: Irreversibly start one paid asynchronous export of up to 10,000 matching people and deliver full personal profiles with real-time verified…
